artboards.title: 2 · Barter Analytics — AD / ED / BNI Office

annotations.text:
Sicilian Barter — design review
Same tokens as the live app (navy #1A1F2E, BNI red #E63946, green #2D9B6F, surface #F0F2F7, 14px radii, Calibri). Polish = tighter type scale, 1px borders instead of heavy shadows, clearer section hierarchy.
Nothing is built yet — these are mockups for your sign-off.
As asked: no expiry countdown anywhere. The inbox shows request AGE instead ("waiting 2h"), which is what drives first-come-first-served urgency.

NEW: Senior DC scope. Sees only barters involving their assigned chapters, with a per-chapter breakdown. Counterparties outside their team are labelled "other team" — they are not given the wider region view.

27 main-category colours, one each. Hues step by the golden angle so alphabetically adjacent categories never look alike.

Honest caveat: 27 colours is past what anyone can tell apart at a glance. They work as identity markers beside a label; in charts, colour the top 6-8 and group the rest.
